messages:
Sam: FYI reprocess job reprocess-2026-03-20 failed preflight: tenant_quota_exceeded (used: 95%, allowed: 90%). Need a plan for backfills that hit short-lived quota spikes.
Mira: Can you paste the preflight output? Is this coming from the console or API-run?
Sam: Console preflight. Snippet: ```json
{
  "job_id": "reprocess-2026-03-20",
  "simulated_policy": "conservative",
  "tenant_quota": 90,
  "estimated_use": 95
}
```
Tobias: We've seen this before when console simulates conservative routing (no burst) but the actual Dedicated routing could accept brief bursts. Console safety errs on the side of blocking.
Arjun: Agreed. We should let operators simulate other routing policies in the preflight so they can see realistic outcomes: e.g., simulate routing_policy=burst_allowed or routing_policy=dedicated_spill.
Mira: UX thought: add a small "Run preflight as" dropdown with options: conservative, burst_allowed, cost_aware. Default remains conservative but show the diff.
Sam: Short-term: I need an API param to reproduce the console behavior from CI. Right now console doesn't expose which routing policy it used.
Tobias: Console calls /preflight/dry-run with internal flag `ui_sim=true` and `policy=console_default` which maps to conservative. API endpoint accepts `policy` but devs aren't surfacing it.
Arjun: Proposal: (1) add `simulate_policy` optional param to preflight API, (2) console exposes dropdown and logs the policy used in the preview, (3) add a one-off operator override token for urgent backfills that bypasses quota for up to 2 hours with audit logging.
Mira: Security/finance question: who can grant operator override? We can't make it a click for everyone. Need RBAC and an approval flow.
Sam: Operator override workflow: request -> auto-check -> 2 approver emails OR 1 approver + SRE on-call ack. Keep it heavy.
Tobias: Implementation detail: the preflight estimator must be deterministic across policy sims. Add a sim_hash so console and API sims produce the same numbers.
Arjun: Example curl for simulating burst_allowed: ```
curl -X POST https://api.internal/preflight/dry-run -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"job_id":"reprocess-2026-03-20","simulate_policy":"burst_allowed"}' | jq .
```
Sam: Ran that with our infra token, and `estimated_use` dropped to 81% under burst_allowed. So the backfill would have been allowed in reality.
Mira: Great. UX: show both numbers side-by-side with a small tooltip: "policy simulates routing behavior; production may differ if capacity changes". Also show audit link for override requests.
Tobias: opsbot: created ticket ENG-7014 "preflight: simulate routing policy + operator override flow" with acceptance criteria and mockups.
opsbot: Ticket ENG-7014 created and assigned to eng-platform backlog.
deploy-bot: rollout: preflight-service v0.42 -> staged canary in namespace preflight-sim (1 pod) :rocket:
Arjun: I'll take the API change (simulate_policy param + sim_hash). Mira, can you own the UI dropdown and audit link copy?
Mira: Yep. I'll wire the dropdown to call the API param and add a warning banner when selected policy is non-default.
Sam: Thanks. Once canary is healthy we should run a set of 10 real dry-runs across tenants to verify parity before enabling override request flow.
Tobias: Agreed. Also add a metric `preflight.sim_mismatch_rate` to alert if console preview vs API sim differ >8%.
Mira: I'll add the copy for the approval flow and make sure the audit trail link is prominent.
Sam: Closing loop: after ENG-7014 lands, operators can request temporary quota tokens and we can avoid manual Slack triage.
Mira: Nice. Assign the follow-ups in the ticket and mark SRE as reviewer.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Ping me if you want to join the dry-run parity test tomorrow morning. :pray:
